# coolify_private_key (Resource)

An SSH private key stored in Coolify, used to reach servers and private git repositories. Coolify rejects keys whose fingerprint already exists.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "coolify_private_key" "deploy" {
  name        = "deploy-key"
  private_key = file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) PEM private key material (or its base64 encoding).

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form description.
- `name` (String) Name of the key. Coolify generates one when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `fingerprint` (String) SSH fingerprint computed by Coolify.
- `uuid` (String) Server-assigned identifier.
